newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Banks boost Estonia bourse to more records.
newsitem.headline: Banks boost Estonia bourse to more records.

text.p: Further interest in bank shares amid hopes that 1997 profit forecasts will be revised pushed the bourse to new closing highs on Friday, dealers said.
Turnover was active at 156.7 million kroons although trade was stopped for 90 minutes in the morning because the bourse had technical problems for the second day running.
The bourse index added 2.16 percent to 351.24, a gain of 5.11 percent during the whole week.
Hansapank was the most active stock and gained 5.25 kroons to close at 195 kroons.
Forekspank added six kroons to 222.50 kroons and Hoiupank was higher 4.20 kroons to close at 204 kroons.
"Investors are playing on expected news," a dealer said, highlighting hopes for more upward revisions in profit forecasts after strong first-half results.
Of the top five banks, only Foreks has so far raised its profit forecast but Hoiupank, Hansapank and Uhispank are all expected to follow suit.
On the free market, Norma turned over 4.3 million kroons to close at 89.50, 1.50 kroons higher.
Rakvere Meat Factory, which released its half-year results, traded 831,700 kroons to be 0.05 higher at 14.05.
